Do you think we could be partners?
You and me in the same agency?
Yes, like real equal partners!
You have already worked with your mother.
It was horrible during the holidays!

I no longer need a boss.
I am the one who needs you.
I want to do this job differently.
Do you really mean it, Dad?
Yes, let us create beautiful memories together.
Then here we go for the adventure!
